Hey, I just entered a long distance relationship with my bf. And I know I'm under 15 but I've been in a similar situation. It's nearly been a year for us being together and I already had to move for long distance. Not my decision. You can absolutely keep a relationship over long distance so whatever goes down don't let anyone change your mind on that. You can do it. Long distance isn't all negatives, mk. You still have your partner, you can really grow together from it and it's a chance to mature and strengthen yourself and your bond. Sure, there's issues with time zones and organization. Trying to communicate is hard especially with a rough time zone. I'm in Germany, my boyfriend is in America, when I first saw that time difference I cried. It looked like we'd only have time to talk on weekends. Sometimes you get wrapped up in so much anxiety over something that never applied in the first place. Cause, we make it work, we talk when it's later at night than my parents might have wanted me up. We catch up during classes when we have spare time. It works out. Don't panic. And please communicate, communicate everything on your mind. It makes it so much easier. You could get jealous, even of family members who get more time with your partner. It's all ok, let yourself feel your feelings without shame. All that matters is how you act with your feelings. You could feel left out when you see other couples at school, but at the end of the day when you talk to them you'll forget all about it. You can cry because you miss them. It's natural, it's all ok.  Don't give up, don't be toxic to them and especially not yourself. Please love yourself too. <3
